notes:
Summary: Demo (10/15) attended by CTO, Head of Product, Security Lead. Strong interest in embeddings + reranking for legal search; wanted private/VPC deployment due to client confidentiality. After the demo they opened the security questionnaire and asked for KMS/HSM details.

Timeline (key events):
- 2024-09-03: Discovery call (Maya Chen) — use cases: fast legal search, precedent summarization, internal doc assistant.
- 2024-09-20: NDA signed and technical intake started.
- 2024-10-01: Deep-dive call with infra + product to map latency/throughput. Target: P95 < 300ms for short chat flows, batch embedding throughput ~2k docs/hr.
- 2024-10-15: Demo (live hosted + sketch of private deployment). Attendees: CTO (Rajiv Patel), Head of Product (Leah Ortiz), Security Lead (Nina Park).
- 2024-10-16: Sent security FAQ + pricing deck (drive:pricing-deck-oxr-v1).
- 2024-10-18: Security questionnaire (JIRA-SEC-612) opened by customer.
- 2024-10-22 to 2024-11-05: Two follow-up emails and one voicemail from AE; no replies.
- 2024-11-12: Heard via mutual contact that finance has put large vendor POCs on hold until Q1 due to budget freeze.

Customer comments / quotes: "Impressive demo — model latency was solid, but we cannot keep data in hosted SaaS for client files; need private deployment and proof of residency." — CTO (Rajiv).
"Price is a key blocker; VendorX has offered a lower-cost flat POC that the board prefers right now." — Head of Product (Leah) paraphrase.

Requirements summary: Private/VPC or on-prem with KMS integration, SOC2 certification and audit logging, data residency assurances for EU clients, per-route latency monitoring, ability to pin model versions and fall back to cheaper model family for high-volume retrieval jobs.

What we proposed: 6-week scaled POC (private tenant) with a focused eval on embeddings + reranking, Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching, and a cost projection. Pricing deck and security FAQ shared.

Why stalled: Post-demo silence. Internal blockers surfaced: (1) no clear internal champion to drive infra procurement — Head of Product overloaded; (2) finance-instigated budget freeze for new vendor POCs until Q1; (3) security team wants HSM/KMS proof and a longer timeline for penetration test; (4) competing lower-cost VendorX being actively evaluated.

AE activity log (recent): Sent pricing follow-up (10/16), technical appendix with KMS details from infra team (10/18), voicemail to CTO (10/25), final outreach email suggesting a narrow POC with finance-friendly price (11/05) — no response.

Next practical moves: Pause heavy engagement. Schedule a re-engagement sequence for mid-Jan (post budget freeze), prepare an abbreviated on-prem demo script and a short HSM/KMS technical pack to reduce security friction, attempt warm intro to an internal champion (legal tech lead) via mutual contact. If we hear back earlier, be ready to propose a 30-day low-cost POC focused on embedding indexing + reranking only.

Notes tone: short bullets above reflect AE notes; CRM follow-ups should reference JIRA-SEC-612 and FF id ff-20241015-oxr-demo-9932 for the demo transcript.
